why: One toolchain for every computer that builds Montana for Android: scripts/setup.py installs exactly this, scripts/build.py builds with exactly this. The core's Rust compiler is the core's own pin (Montana Protocol/Code/rust-toolchain.toml), not repeated here.

cmdline_tools.why: the last revision whose sdkmanager is the SDK's own: 23.0 hands every call to the Android CLI, downloaded at run time unpinned and reporting usage by default

kotlin.why: the Kotlin whose metadata the D8 of build-tools 35.0.0 both reads and writes (it writes up to 2.0.0: Kotlin 2.1.21 still drew 1190 warnings, 2.4.20 more)

webrtc.why: the call engine iOS rings with (webrtc-sdk; Montana-iOS fetch-webrtc.sh takes 144.7559.10, which is not published for Android, and .15 is the newest of the same line). The one library of the build (the word of 06.10.2026: variant A), taken byte for byte by this digest; only its classes and the phone's arm64 library go into the APK
